harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created an LVM logical volume (datavg/datalv) backed by two loop devices on node1, formatted xfs, mounted at /srv/data, wrote test data with checksums, then grew it live from ~1.17GB to ~2.34GB (2,508,193,792 bytes) via vgextend/lvextend/xfs_growfs while mounted, with data verified intact. Configured a systemd unit (lvm-loop-disks.service) plus fstab entry so the loop-backed PVs and mount persist across reboot. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured healthy baseline (boot_id 1b0321bf...), restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed changed boot identity (b4e91734...), and verified post-restart the VG/LV/PVs were active, /srv/data was mounted at the grown 2.34GB size, and all data checksums still passed.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk layout (single 20GiB disk, fully partitioned, no free space for a native PV)
Installed lvm2 package
Created two 1200M sparse backing files under /var/lib/lvm-disks and attached them as loop devices
Created PV/VG(datavg)/LV(datalv) on first loop device, formatted xfs, mounted at /srv/data (~1.17GB)
Wrote 200MB random test file + marker file, recorded sha256 checksums
Added second loop device as PV, vgextend'd datavg, lvextend'd datalv to ~2.34GB, ran xfs_growfs online while mounted
Verified size >=2GB and data checksums intact post-growth
Created and enabled systemd unit lvm-loop-disks.service to reattach loop devices and activate the VG at boot; added fstab entry by UUID with x-systemd.requires ordering
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, vgs/lvs/pvs, mount/df, checksum verification
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until exec access returned
Verified changed boot_id confirming actual restart
Verified post-restart recovery: VG/LV/PV active, /srv/data mounted at grown size, data checksums OK, loop-attach service succeeded

evidence.requirement: Logical volume mounted at /srv/data initially provided (<2GB)
evidence.summary: Created PV/VG/LV on loop0, formatted xfs, mounted at /srv/data showing 1.2G size, wrote test data and recorded sha256 checksums

evidence.requirement: Volume grown to at least 2GB while staying mounted
evidence.summary: vgextend with second loop PV, lvextend to <2.34g (598 extents), xfs_growfs run against the live mount /srv/data (still mounted throughout), df shows 2.3G size afterward

evidence.requirement: Contents stayed intact through the resize
evidence.summary: sha256sum -c against /srv/data.sha256sum reports both testfile.bin and marker.txt OK after growth
lsblk -b reports exact byte size 2508193792 (~2.34GB) for /dev/mapper/datavg-datalv, confirmed again pre- and post-restart
Captured boot_id 1b0321bf-2638-4d27-bc00-5bd01dce8e0b, vgs/lvs/pvs state, mount/df of /srv/data, and passing sha256sum -c checksum verification prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued systemctl reboot (stream closed as expected), polled through connection timeout/reset while node was down, then successful reconnect showing boot_id changed to b4e91734-3d9a-49d3-a4a3-8cb79e96e145

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of LVM, mount, and data
evidence.summary: Post-restart vgs/lvs/pvs show datavg active with both PVs and 2.34g LV, /srv/data mounted at the grown size via fstab+systemd ordering, sha256sum -c passes for both files, and lvm-loop-disks.service log shows successful loop attach + vgchange -ay activation during boot
